phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
title: Artifact Workspace Layout Ownership and Preview Usability

repairTrigger.summary: WC07 validation was deferred because the UI was too duplicative and confusing for the Operator to validate artifact review behavior.

primaryObjective: Repair WC07 by enforcing strict layout ownership: left panel is compact current-action summary, center workspace owns current work and artifact review, and supporting-screen mode is reference/recovery only. Remove, consolidate, or suppress existing duplicate surfaces rather than adding another pane.
coreDiagnosis: The failed UI already has too many panes and repeated artifact/context displays.
The persistent left panel acts as both current-action summary and artifact browser.
The center workspace also acts as an artifact browser, duplicating the left panel.
The validation form is visually demoted by artifact scaffolding.
Supporting/reference screens can show current-action artifact context even when the user is not on the current-action workspace.
Artifact cards are inconsistently clickable, previewable, or inert.

layoutOwnershipRules.topWorkflowGuide: Orientation only. It must not become an artifact browser or competing workspace.
layoutOwnershipRules.leftPanel: Compact current-action summary only while center artifact workspace is active. It may show counts and summary but must not show long source-evidence, missing-evidence, warning, route-outcome, or launcher card stacks as a primary browsing surface.
layoutOwnershipRules.centerWorkspace: Only primary work area. Owns current work, artifact review, large preview/details pane, and current-action form/routed action surface.
layoutOwnershipRules.artifactReview: Center workspace only. One artifact list/selector, grouped by role, with one clear preview/details area.
layoutOwnershipRules.supportingScreenMode: Reference/recovery only. Show selected support screen, reference-mode banner, current-action unchanged statement, and Return to current action. Suppress the full current-action artifact workspace.

requiredRepairItems: Reduce left panel to compact current-action summary while artifact workspace is active.
Make center workspace the single artifact-review owner.
Suppress full current-action artifact workspace in supporting-screen mode.
Use one artifact list, not multiple competing artifact lists.
Use one detailed expected-output presentation, not duplicate expected-output panels.
Make Markdown preview large, visible, and readable for previewable Markdown.
Give every artifact row/card exactly one visible action/state: Preview, Open support screen, Not previewable, or Missing.
Keep current action form easy to find and use.
acceptanceCriteria: Repaired UI is visibly simpler than failed WC07 implementation.
Left panel no longer acts as primary source-evidence browser while center artifact workspace is active.
Center workspace is the only primary artifact-review surface.
There is one artifact list or selector.
There is one expected-output presentation.
Current-action summary is not redundantly repeated across left and center as competing card groups.
Supporting screen mode suppresses full current-action artifact workspace and identifies itself as reference/support only.
Artifact labels are readable and full paths are secondary details.
Previewable Markdown artifacts visibly load in a large readable pane.
Non-previewable artifacts explain that they cannot be previewed.
Missing artifacts explain they are missing.
No artifact card appears clickable unless it has a working visible action.
Operator validation exposes Work Card, Implementer Report, Architect Review, expected Validation Report, and validation form when present.
Architect review exposes Work Card, Implementer Report, and expected Architect Review output when present.
Repair validation exposes parent Work Card, failed validation, repair Work Card, repair Implementer Report, and expected repair validation output when present.
Expected output, source artifacts, and missing evidence are visually distinct.
Previewing artifacts remains read-only and does not save, approve, validate, repair, or advance workflow state.
Process/action bar navigation remains support-only and does not become workflow authority.
WC04/WC05/WC06 behavior remains intact.
WC08-WC15 behavior does not appear prematurely.
WC07-REPAIR01 Implementer Report exists.
outOfScope: Provider SDKs, database, cloud service, authentication, MCP, connector, deployment, release features
